cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-79 requires user input to be placed in web page output served to other users. This code loads a script from Vimeo's API for the current user's session, not for serving to other users.

connection.evidence: Vimeo ID from data-vimeo DOM attribute flows through vimeoApi template to script.src assignment and document.head.appendChild

diff_causality.evidence: The script.src assignment is part of the JSONP implementation, not a patch that creates or modifies XSS vulnerability

security_control.evidence: No client-side validation of Vimeo ID format, but this is a JSONP API call to Vimeo's trusted domain
security_control.required_control: Input validation for script source URLs
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-79 requires neutralization of user input placed in web page output
existing_controls_checked: Vimeo API server-side validation (assumed but not verified)
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No client-side validation of Vimeo ID, but the demonstrated use case is legitimate JSONP API consumption, not serving content to other users

concrete_impact.evidence: No evidence of XSS impact since this loads scripts from Vimeo's trusted domain for the current user's session only

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the JSONP functionality would break entirely, preventing Vimeo thumbnail loading but not creating an XSS vulnerability.
supporting_evidence: User-controlled Vimeo ID flows to script.src assignment
Dynamic script element creation and injection into document.head
contradicting_evidence: Script loads from vimeo.com trusted domain, not arbitrary URLs
JSONP callback is auto-generated and properly cleaned up
Function serves current user's session, not content for other users
unresolved_facts: Whether Vimeo API properly validates ID format server-side
If there are client-side restrictions on Vimeo ID characters
Whether this code could be abused to load arbitrary scripts
